svg.title: Whole-model inference latency and HT-Policy speedup
svg.desc: NVIDIA RTX 5090, batch size 1. Lower latency is better. GR00T N1.7: Flow-Policy 46.20 ms, HT-Policy 24.52 ms; 1.88 times faster. π₀.₅: Flow-Policy 123.58 ms, HT-Policy 67.94 ms; 1.82 times faster. Cosmos3-Nano: Flow-Policy 1271.76 ms, HT-Policy 71.34 ms; 17.83 times faster. Each model's Flow-Policy latency is 100%. Endpoint labels show measured milliseconds; speedup is Flow-Policy latency divided by HT-Policy latency. One policy query produces an action chunk. Includes observation encoding and action prediction from preprocessed GPU inputs; excludes input/output processing, environment execution, and video decoding. No gradient computation or compilation.
